text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The absolute worst... To think I'd lose 
again...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What did I do wrong? Not enough guts? 
Effort? Luck? Or is it just talent?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to become the 'real me' like 
this... It's just way too uncool...!
choice_data_list: Let's not rush and just keep at it.

You never give up, even when you look 
uncool—that's who you are!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...No lie, I'm feeling rushed. I don't 
want people thinking this is just some 
model's hobby, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the most patient person. So 
there's no way I'm losing the next race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll let this impatience drive me and get 
stronger. This time, I'm gonna prove how 
strong the real "me" is!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, nobody would ever say looking 
uncool is just "me" back when I was 
modeling.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, facts are facts: it's totally 
lame... If it's this uncool, pretty soon 
no one's gonna pay any attention to me."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Being completely overlooked is so 
frustrating. I'll win next time and really 
show them...!
